description: What scripts/gen-rules-index.py reads from text.md: each rule's line, the roles it binds, how its role was read, whether it is a reader's, its rule ids and its evidence, in the text's order; the rule ids of its tables, each with the roles its row binds; and the lines of unreadable.md whose rule names no role the script can read, each refused. text.md holds a rule of each reading: a section §12 lists as static (§1 and §3.1), a subject, a pronoun after it in its paragraph, a passive's agent, two roles and a lead-in's list, a continuation's evidence, a MAY's subject before a pronoun, role labels in a table row, a pronoun whose antecedent leads the sentence before it, a reader, a section's id and a lint code. unreadable.md holds what must fail: a subject with no role, a pronoun with no antecedent, one whose antecedent is a paragraph back, a role label's role past the sentence it opens, a section §12 does not list, and a section's title, which names no rule's role.
